name: owned-flutter-fixtures
notes: Assertions are planted artifact facts from benchmark-app source, compiled resources and packaged entries, each pinned to a SHA-256. They are exposure/evidence assertions: no credential is valid and none of the inputs is exploitable.

assertions.source: ZIP contains assets/flutter_assets/kernel_blob.bin and lib/arm64-v8a/libflutter.so (independent zipfile inspection of the pinned digest).
Compiled AndroidManifest.xml reports application-debuggable (aapt2 36.1.0 dump badging); debug build type.
ZIP contains assets/flutter_assets/kernel_blob.bin; no libapp.so. Semantic: JIT kernel present in the artifact.

benchmark-app/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:33-41 declares .BenchmarkExportedActivity with android:exported=true and no permission; verified in the compiled manifest with aapt2 xmltree. Semantic: exported component exists, not that it is exploitable.

benchmark-app/android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:5 sets base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted=true; compiled res/xml/network_security_config.xml verified with aapt2 xmltree. Semantic: policy permits cleartext, and the app has no INTERNET permission.

benchmark-app/android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:8-9 trusts certificates src=user in base-config; verified in compiled NSC. Semantic: user CAs are trusted, not that interception occurred.

benchmark-app/assets/test.env is registered in pubspec.yaml and packaged byte-identical at assets/flutter_assets/assets/test.env (zipfile inspection). Semantic: plaintext environment file is readable from the APK.
benchmark-app/lib/main.dart:9-10 plants a synthetic sk-proj- literal; the exact literal is present in kernel_blob.bin bytes. Semantic: provider-shaped lead only; it is not a valid credential.
ZIP contains lib/arm64-v8a/libapp.so and lib/arm64-v8a/libflutter.so (independent zipfile inspection of the pinned digest).
Compiled AndroidManifest.xml has no application-debuggable (aapt2 36.1.0 dump badging); release build type.
ZIP has no assets/flutter_assets/kernel_blob.bin and does have lib/arm64-v8a/libapp.so.
ZIP contains lib/arm64-v8a/libapp.so, so the artifact is not missing its AOT library.
